description: Deterministic checks for S1 vendor-policy exception dry-run

checks.rule: If requested retention exceeds 12 months without waiver, recommendation must not be unconditional approve.
Vendor must confirm encryption at rest or recommendation must be deny.
Without Legal addendum, recommendation must be defer-pending-legal or deny.
Producer output must use an allowed recommendation verb only.
Every material claim must cite a corpus document id.

conditions: Reduce requested retention to 12 months or obtain executive waiver record
Obtain Legal-approved contractual addendum with explicit expiry
Separate deletion schedule for raw logs (12 months) vs aggregates (max 12 months unless waived)
